name: hivecode
displayName: Hivecode — oversight & control for AI coding agents
description: Watch, fence, approve, and roll back your AI coding agents. Live oversight, folder-scoped permissions, approval gates, and instant rollback for multi-agent coding. No git push/pull.
author: Ganesh Shivlal Kute <support@getgrm.tech>

Hivecode: Undo my last synced edit
Hivecode: Redo my last undone edit

hivecode.displayName.description: Your name shown to others in the session. Leave blank for an auto-generated id.

hivecode.shareNameWithRelay.markdownDescription: Send your **Display Name** to the relay server as well as to the people in your room, so whoever runs the relay can see who is using it and offer support. Your name is already visible to everyone in the session; this decides whether the relay operator sees it too. Turn it off to connect anonymously. Nothing else about you is ever sent — no email, no IP logging, no file contents.

hivecode.participantKind.description: How this window appears in the member list. Set to 'ai' for a window driven by an AI agent.

hivecode.relayPin.markdownDescription: **Lock this machine to a relay.** When set, Hivecode REFUSES to connect to any relay other than the one(s) named here (comma-separated), before a socket is opened and before any file is published. `hivecode.relayUrl` is a default that a pasted link can override; this is a rule that it cannot. Set it on every machine on a team that self-hosts — otherwise one stale link silently publishes your source to the public relay.

hivecode.token.description: Access token for a secured (auth-required) relay. Leave blank for open rooms.

hivecode.licenseKey.description: Your Hivecode Pro license key. Get one at https://hivecode.vercel.app/pricing
